subject.title: ci: defer macOS tests for draft pull requests

question: Should code-changing draft pull requests receive a successful aggregate required check before their macOS shards have run?
rationale: The patch implements the policy cleanly, but only the repository owner can accept the branch-protection semantics and runner-capacity tradeoff, and current evidence does not prove the transition window is merge-safe.

options.title: Keep required gate unsatisfied
options.body: Report draft deferral separately and let the required aggregate gate become successful only after the ready-for-review macOS run passes.

options.title: Approve aggregate-green drafts
options.body: Keep the patch as written after a controlled draft-to-ready test proves branch protection blocks merge until the new same-SHA macOS run completes.

recommendation.title: Keep required gate unsatisfied
recommendation.body: Report draft deferral separately and let the required aggregate gate become successful only after the ready-for-review macOS run passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner controls the intended required-check and macOS runner policy.
